messages:
alex: Quick sync — saw another spike in cross-region retries this morning. Looks similar to last week's spiral. Noticed more TLS handshakes failing from eu-west to us-east-2 around 03:12 UTC.

maria: Ugh. Any new error patterns in the logs?

cheng: Early look: increased 525/526 TLS failure counters on edge-lb-eu-01 -> gateway-us-02. See snippet from the probe: `TLS handshake: alert handshake_failure (40)`, repeated ~12s intervals.

sam: Confirmed. Also saw repeated 503s from routing proxy before fallback kicks in. Likely a combo of SNI flapping + rebalancing causing connection churn.

ops-bot: Incident alert created: INC-2027-2185. Auto-attach: recent-deploy-check, crossregion-latency.

linda: Adding ownership: I'll take coordination for routing rule audit. @cheng can you own kernel/handshake analysis? @maria can you run the per-flow tls-cert-match query and share heatmap?

cheng: I can. Will run `logs.query("tls.alert=handshake_failure AND src=eu-west").group_by(node).count()` and post results in 20m.

maria: Running the cert-match query now. Early result: ~30% of failed connections show SNI mismatch vs cert on the target. Seems config drift on a subset of instances.

alex: Ok that's actionable. Action items: 1) cheng - root-cause TLS failures, 2) linda - routing rule sweep + backlog ticket, 3) sam - deploy safeguard (rate-limited backoff) to avoid cascade. Set target EOD for initial remediation check-in.

devon: I'll draft a short canary plan to disable the problematic host pool for eu-west and route to fallback for 10m windows. Want to test if retries drop.

sam: Please include a fallback policy that increases exponential backoff from 1s->8s so we don't hit upstream too hard. Example config snippet:```json
{"retry": {"strategy": "exp", "base_ms": 1000, "max_ms": 8000, "max_attempts": 3}}
```

alex: Good. Also we need a timeline in the postmortem follow-up doc: immediate mitigation, 48h remediation (configs), 2-week larger fix (router version + kernel TLS patch). Linda please file with owners and due dates.

linda: Filing now: PM-INC-2185-REM with sections: mitigation, RCA owners, tests, rollout plan, and post-deploy verification steps. Assigning tentative due dates: 48h for config rollouts (owner: linda), 2w for runtime patch (owner: cheng).

cheng: Found two instances where nginx SNI config reverted to default cert after last config push. Investigating deploy pipeline that touched TLS symlinks.

maria: Heatmap attached in ticket — shows clustering on edge-lb-eu-01 and edge-lb-eu-02 at the same times as failed handshakes.

alex: Next steps: 1) devon to run the disable-test now (start + 10m), 2) sam to apply backoff patch to routing proxy, 3) cheng to confirm symlink fix + write unit test for deploy that ensures cert symlink persisted. Quick check-in at +45m in this thread.

devon: Starting canary disable in 2m. Will post metrics link.

ops-bot: Canary run started by devon. Canary ID: cny-207999-01. Monitoring window: 10m.

sam: Pushed backoff config to staging; prepping to promote to canary path after devon confirms.

cheng: Found the flawed deploy job: `deploy/web-edge:post-release` runs `chown` which overwrote symlinks when user mismatch occurs. Patch ready, will upstream PR after quick unit test.

maria: Canary metrics: retries decreased ~78% during disable window, TLS alerts fell to baseline. Link: https://dashboards/redwood/canary/cny-207999-01

alex: That's promising. Please capture the exact graphs in postmortem doc. If canary holds, proceed with staged rollout of the routing change and the deploy patch next week.

linda: Created tasks in PM-INC-2185-REM: TASK-1 (canary notes), TASK-2 (routing backoff rollout), TASK-3 (deploy-patch PR). Assigned owners and due dates.

cheng: PR: https://git/redwood/edgedeploy/pull/1425 — includes fix + unit test for symlink persistence. Requesting review from infra-team.

devon: Canary ended. Metrics look stable. Will schedule 1h maintenance window to remove bad hosts from rotation tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

alex: Thanks team. Follow-up: weekly check for recurring pattern - add a recurring ticket to monitor TLS-handshake_failure spikes across regions (owner: sam). If we see 3 occurrences in 30 days, escalate to oncall lead.

sam: Will add alert rule: `sum(tls.handshake_failure) by region > threshold for 5m -> page oncall` and a separate suppressed alert for ongoing canary.

maria: Closing loop: I'll add the final heatmaps and evidence to PM-INC-2185-REM and mark TASK-1 ready for review.

alex: Great. Check-in in 45m for status updates. :thumbsup:
